message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which can fluctuate daily. As a rough estimate, if the rate is about $1 ≈ £0.78, then:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;(\text{GBP per USD}) \;\approx\; £15.60
\]

Keep in mind that the exact amount may vary slightly depending on the day’s rate and any fees your bank or service might charge.
